title: RED - A Color or an Understanding
bodyHtml:
1st Red: How?

Imagine the color red right now. Imagine the color red that is to another person. Do you think you'll see the same red? How can we know if the other sees blue but because he thinks blue is red when I show a red to both of you, you all say it's red. There is a communication barrier! In school, when the color red was shown, they told you it was called red. But if someone else sees the red color as pink maybe then too he will call it red! It is mind-bending so, feel free to read it again. This is a great line of thought, is my red your red?


I got this thought during my childhood, but due to a lack of evidence, I cannot prove it is mine. A Vsauce video much after has described the same phenomenon, and hence this is an honorable mention!


2nd Red: What?

Imagine writing all books from the past, present, and future of all universes in red ink on an A4-size paper. You are overwriting on the same page as you come at the end of the page. Now, imagine drawing every kind of drawing possible from the past, present, and future from all Universes possible on the same A4 size page. Imagine you wrote, drew, sketched, painted, and typed everything possible on 1 A4 size paper in red. The whole page would turn red right? It would be just a blank plain red piece of paper.


Now look at anything red in your surrounding, don't you feel it is your lack of perception that you cannot find the answer to a formula or a math sum there, because a plain red color might contain your answer too. I mean every kind of problem and solution is written everywhere you see. Everything is all around you it is just that you are incompetent or unreceptive of the surrounding, of the answers you are looking for.


This is just one of my thought, whenever I feel depressed I just think about this and realize the Universe has presented me with everything, and now it is my action that defines me. I come out with a new sense of profoundness just thinking about this.


3rd Red: Where?


This final question ends with a more meaningful question. Firstly, let's see why I chose red for my ideology?

Red, I am talking about the blood. It marks the presence of life example, when we were born we were covered in blood right? It is the symbolic representation of a new beginning and after reading this, I want it to affect you in a way that marks your new quest.


The colors that we see are where actually? You might say outside example, it is the color of your pen or marker or the color on your friend's shirt. But this isn't true!

Scientifically speaking, the light hits the object, certain frequencies are reflected and the rest are absorbed. The reflected frequency is comprehended as red in your mind. This is exactly how computers work, low voltage is assumed as zero and high voltage as one by the CPU, and our experiences too, are simply a way of the brain's manipulation. Everything you know as real is just some make of your mind. So, the real question is where? Where is everything? You might say inside right.


So, assuming you are correct, tell me where is inside? If you say inside the brain, I think there is no place inside the brain because it is a body organ. I want you to ask more questions about yourself, to yourself. Your position in the body, where do you lie in the body, and for that matter who are you?
summary: Three questions about color, perception, information, and where experience resides—an early philosophical essay written before discovering Vsauce’s treatment of the same idea.
